name: Stuart Mead
description: The PLACE19 programme lists Stuart Mead, a research officer at Massey University, jointly demonstrating satellite-data access and Google Earth Engine with Gabor Kereszturi. His biography connects computational earth science and volcanic hazard modelling with interactive spatial information.
